Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Quito hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 18 Quito hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: the hotel's own site at 4, Reservation Day at 3, trivago DEALS at 3, Super.com at 2, Agoda at 1, pricetravel.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Viajero Quito Hostel at 1. These are the Quito rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Quito hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 2% at Springhills Quito Airport to 32% at Hotel NH Collection Quito Royal. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
